newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech bank postpones mortgage bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Czech bank postpones mortgage bond issue.

text.p: Ceska Sporitelna, the largest Czech savings bank on Wednesday said it was postponing a planned mortgage bond issue until next year due to unfavourable market conditions created by recent central bank moves.

"We decided to postpone the issue until the beginning of next year... (because) the measures of the central bank would increase the costs of the mortgage bonds," Vladimir Kotlar, deputy general director of Sporitelna told a news conference, giving no further details.
